output.question: Where can I find Hermès' latest annual report?
output.answer: The latest annual report from Hermès International is its 2025 Universal Registration Document (URD). Hermès filed it with the French market regulator (AMF) on 19 March 2026 in ESEF format, and it contains the 2025 Annual Financial Report. You can get it on Hermès' investor site, finance.hermes.com, under Publications or Regulated information. The English PDF is at https://assets-finance.hermes.com/s3fs-public/node/pdf_file/2026-04/1777391712/260320_hermes_urd2025_en.pdf, and there is an online version at https://hermes.fr.digital-report.net/en/report/5309. Hermès usually files its URD in March, so the 2026 report is not expected until around March 2027.

key_facts.fact: Hermès International filed its 2025 Universal Registration Document with the AMF on 19 March 2026, in ESEF format.

The 2025 URD includes the 2025 Annual Financial Report, the parent company and consolidated financial statements, the sustainability report, the corporate governance report, and the resolutions for the 17 April 2026 General Meeting.
The press release says the document is on finance.hermes.com, in the Investors section under Publications and Regulated information.
The Hermès finance Publications page lists the 2025 URD as the latest annual report, with a PDF link and a link to the online version.

passages.quote: Hermès International filed its 2025 Universal Registration Document with the Financial Markets Authority (AMF), on 19 March 2026, in ESEF format.
Investors section: Publications and Regulated information (finance.hermes.com)

2025 Universal Registration Document (including the annual financial report) — Access in PDF: https://assets-finance.hermes.com/s3fs-public/node/pdf_file/2026-04/1777391712/260320_hermes_urd2025_en.pdf

caveats: The press release wording was read on webdisclosure.com, which republishes it. The Nasdaq copy timed out, so I could not compare the two.
The Publications page does not show a publication date. The '260320' in the PDF filename and the '2026-04' in its path may be internal upload dates.
Hermès also publishes half-year reports, which are separate. The 2026 half-year report may be out already, but it is not the annual report.
Hermès did not file a 2026 URD before today (2026-11-11). Based on past years, the next one should come out around March 2027.
